view_method: Remote YouTube browser playback only; muted, paused and advanced with native player frame shortcut. No remote movie download or redistribution.

observations.motion: Strong forward forelimb reach and rearward hindlimb silhouette; body visibly extended.
Fore contact and rearward fore support while hindlimbs gather forward.
Fore wrists fold deeply beneath chest; hind knees and paws gather beneath abdomen; collected silhouette.
Hind support accompanies renewed forward fore reach.
Similar support/collection sequence recurs, suggesting approximately .70s displayed cycle.

limits: Displayed ~.70s pace is a stylistic reference; true filming fps, playback retiming and capture provenance are unknown.
Overlay breed-speed claims are not used to set game speed or anatomical measurements.
Compression blur and ghosted feet are not copied as literal anatomy.
Reference opening Shepherd is a movement guide for the preserved Labrador, not a model/breed replacement.
